set.body:
Objective
Ship runnable classification, reusable relation and global-fit/confirmation/group journeys with concise façades and inspectable intermediate specifications. Document breaking old-to-new migration and claim limits.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements FND-08, FND-09, PRED-01, REL-01, PAT-03, GRP-02, OPS-01. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
documentation and independent usability; docs/examples for mvpa, mvpa-fit, mvpa-spatial/dataset; native inspection and qualified export views. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M3.15, M4.10, M5.03. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Exercise real tasks: repair an axis mismatch, explain missing residuals, add RSA without refitting, change a fold safely and explain unavailable inference.
2. Check correctness, unnecessary reads/refits, failed attempts, bounded context/output and truthful coverage reporting on the production API.
3. Maps/artifacts clearly label task pattern versus decoder/filter versus conditional importance; unsupported durable profiles remain explicit.
4. Independent usability review feeds bounded API fixes back through owning tickets; no agent server, global DSL or compatibility wrapper is required.

Verification
sbt mvpaJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaJS/test
sbt mvpaFitJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaFitJS/test
sbt mvpaSpatialJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaSpatialJS/test
sbt mvpaDatasetJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaDatasetJS/test
These are candidate owning-module gates at the planning baseline: resolve any renamed module/test IDs at implementation start, and include affected consumer/parity scenarios. Use independent oracles and explicit tolerances; never report pending tests as passing.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M5.06: Deliver analyst-facing workflows and independently review native API usability
